scripts.//prebuild: Purge the webpack module cache before a release build. Next's incremental cache (.next/cache) can re-emit a STALE compiled module after a source edit (observed under OneDrive/Windows mtime quirks), which silently shipped a build that ignored a source fix. A release artifact must compile from source every time — this forces a full recompile (only affects `build`, not `dev`).
scripts.//clean:next: Purge the ENTIRE .next (server + static + cache), not just the cache. An incremental `next build` over a stale .next/server + .next/static (under OneDrive/Windows mtime quirks) can ship an artifact whose RSC/manifest references client-chunk state the emitted static chunks don't match — the published 0.2.15 did exactly this, crashing /login at hydration with 'invariant expected layout router to be mounted'. The release build must start from an empty .next.
scripts.//build:release: Clean, from-scratch production build for the artifact that ships. `validate` (the pre-publish gate) uses this; plain `build` stays incremental for fast local iteration.
scripts.//smoke: Pre-publish smoke gate: boots the built package in isolation and loads /login (signin + signup) in headless Chrome, asserting no 'invariant expected layout router' / 'broke at the root'. Run after `validate`, before `npm publish`. Catches a bad .next artifact before it ever ships.

scripts.test.electron.main: run-s clean.temp build && cross-env INCLUDE_COMPAT_TESTS=true SKIP_GC_TESTS=true electron-mocha ./test/unit/*-test.ts ./test/unit/compat/*-test.ts
scripts.test.electron.renderer: run-s build && cross-env INCLUDE_COMPAT_TESTS=true SKIP_GC_TESTS=true electron-mocha --renderer ./test/unit/*-test.ts ./test/unit/compat/*-test.ts

scripts.test:convertpdf: cd examples/convertpdf && npm install && npm run start-nobrowser

scripts.clean: del-cli android/build example/android/build example/android/app/build example/ios/build lib

scripts.dev: ZIDANE_DEV=1 ZIDANE_DEBUG=1 ZIDANE_EXTENSION_DIRS=../extensions bun --watch run src/cli.ts
ZIDANE_DEV=1 ZIDANE_DEBUG=1 ZIDANE_EXTENSION_DIRS=../extensions bun --watch run src/cli.ts

scripts.build:native: zig build -Dnapi-include=node_modules/node-api-headers/include && mkdir -p dist/bin && cp zig-out/lib/libzig_id.so dist/bin/x86_64-linux-gnu/zig-id.node
scripts.build:all: npm run build:native && npm run build

scripts.verify:all: npm run test:zod3 && npm run test:zod4 && npm run typecheck:zod3 && npm run typecheck:zod4 && npm run lint
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run test && npm run lint

scripts.verdaccio:publish: npm unpublish --registry http://localhost:4873 --force && npm publish --registry http://localhost:4873 --force

scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.prepack: npm run clean && npm run build

scripts.build: export NODE_ENV=production && npm run clear && npm run babel
scripts.prepare: npm run test:ci && npm run lint && npm run build
